#==============================================================================
# ** Vacas - Pantallas
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Aviso de contenido al arrancar, titulo en castellano, fin del acto y
#  game over propio.
#==============================================================================

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Utilidad: texto centrado sobre negro
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
module Vacas
  def self.sprite_texto(lineas, y0, alto = 30, tam = 22, color = nil)
    s = Sprite.new
    s.bitmap = Bitmap.new(640, 480)
    s.bitmap.font.size = tam
    c = color
    if c.nil?
      c = Color.new(210, 200, 180)
    end
    s.bitmap.font.color = c
    y = y0
    for l in lineas
      s.bitmap.draw_text(0, y, 640, alto, l, 1)
      y += alto
    end
    return s
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# ** Scene_Aviso - aviso de contenido (solo al arrancar el juego)
#==============================================================================
class Scene_Aviso
  def main
    @fondo = Sprite.new
    @fondo.bitmap = Bitmap.new(640, 480)
    @fondo.bitmap.fill_rect(0, 0, 640, 480, Color.new(0, 0, 0))
    @titulo = Vacas.sprite_texto(["AVISO DE CONTENIDO"], 70, 36, 28,
      Color.new(190, 40, 34))
    lineas = [
      "Vacas es un juego de terror psicológico para adultos.",
      "",
      "Contiene maltrato familiar y psicológico, violencia,",
      "sangre, imágenes perturbadoras sobre la carne y los",
      "animales de matadero, y temas de salud mental.",
      "",
      "No contiene escenas sexuales.",
      "",
      "Si en algún momento te hace daño, para. El juego espera."
    ]
    @texto = Vacas.sprite_texto(lineas, 140, 28, 20)
    @pie = Vacas.sprite_texto(["Pulsa Intro para continuar"], 420, 28, 16,
      Color.new(140, 130, 115))
    @pie.opacity = 0
    @espera = 0
    Graphics.transition(40)
    loop do
      Graphics.update
      Input.update
      @espera += 1
      if @espera > 60
        @pie.opacity = 120 + (Graphics.frame_count % 60) * 2
      else
        @pie.opacity = 0
      end
      if @espera > 60 and Input.trigger?(Input::C)
        $scene = Scene_Title.new
      end
      break if $scene != self
    end
    Graphics.freeze
    for s in [@fondo, @titulo, @texto, @pie]
      s.bitmap.dispose
      s.dispose
    end
    Graphics.transition(30)
    Graphics.freeze
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# ** Scene_Title - en castellano y con los graficos propios
#==============================================================================
class Scene_Title
  def main
    if $BTEST
      battle_test
      return
    end
    $data_actors        = load_data("Data/Actors.rxdata")
    $data_classes       = load_data("Data/Classes.rxdata")
    $data_skills        = load_data("Data/Skills.rxdata")
    $data_items         = load_data("Data/Items.rxdata")
    $data_weapons       = load_data("Data/Weapons.rxdata")
    $data_armors        = load_data("Data/Armors.rxdata")
    $data_enemies       = load_data("Data/Enemies.rxdata")
    $data_troops        = load_data("Data/Troops.rxdata")
    $data_states        = load_data("Data/States.rxdata")
    $data_animations    = load_data("Data/Animations.rxdata")
    $data_tilesets      = load_data("Data/Tilesets.rxdata")
    $data_common_events = load_data("Data/CommonEvents.rxdata")
    $data_system        = load_data("Data/System.rxdata")
    Vacas.ajustar_sistema
    $game_system = Game_System.new
    @sprite = Sprite.new
    @sprite.bitmap = RPG::Cache.title($data_system.title_name)
    @command_window = Window_Command.new(200, ["Nueva partida", "Continuar", "Salir"])
    @command_window.back_opacity = 140
    @command_window.x = 320 - @command_window.width / 2
    @command_window.y = 350
    @continue_enabled = false
    for i in 0..3
      if FileTest.exist?("Save#{i+1}.rxdata")
        @continue_enabled = true
      end
    end
    if @continue_enabled
      @command_window.index = 1
    else
      @command_window.disable_item(1)
    end
    $game_system.bgm_play($data_system.title_bgm)
    Audio.me_stop
    Audio.bgs_stop
    Graphics.transition(40)
    loop do
      Graphics.update
      Input.update
      update
      break if $scene != self
    end
    Graphics.freeze
    @command_window.dispose
    @sprite.bitmap.dispose
    @sprite.dispose
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# ** Scene_FinActo - "Fin del Acto I / II"
#   Acto 1: al pulsar Intro sigue en el Acto II (misma partida).
#   Acto 2: vuelve al titulo.
#==============================================================================
class Scene_FinActo
  TEXTOS = {
    1 => ["Fin del Acto I", "El piso", "Acto II: La cadena", "Pulsa Intro para seguir"],
    2 => ["Fin del Acto II", "La cadena", "Acto III: Lucy", "Pulsa Intro para seguir"],
    3 => ["Fin del Acto III", "Lucy", "Acto IV: Bajo la ciudad", "Pulsa Intro para seguir"],
    4 => ["Fin del Acto IV", "Bajo la ciudad", "Continuará en el Acto V: La matanza", "Pulsa Intro para volver al título"]
  }
  def initialize(acto = 1)
    @acto = acto
  end
  def main
    Audio.bgm_fade(2000)
    Audio.bgs_fade(2000)
    t = TEXTOS[@acto]
    @fondo = Sprite.new
    @fondo.bitmap = Bitmap.new(640, 480)
    @fondo.bitmap.fill_rect(0, 0, 640, 480, Color.new(0, 0, 0))
    @fin = Vacas.sprite_texto([t[0]], 170, 50, 40, Color.new(170, 30, 26))
    @sub = Vacas.sprite_texto([t[1]], 224, 32, 22)
    @sig = Vacas.sprite_texto([t[2]], 330, 28, 18, Color.new(140, 130, 115))
    @pie = Vacas.sprite_texto([t[3]], 420, 24, 14, Color.new(110, 100, 90))
    for s in [@fin, @sub, @sig, @pie]
      s.opacity = 0
    end
    Graphics.transition(60)
    $game_system.me_play(RPG::AudioFile.new("015-Mystery01", 80, 70))
    @t = 0
    loop do
      Graphics.update
      Input.update
      @t += 1
      @fin.opacity = (@t - 20) * 3 if @t > 20
      @sub.opacity = (@t - 100) * 3 if @t > 100
      @sig.opacity = (@t - 200) * 2 if @t > 200
      @pie.opacity = 60 + (@t % 80) * 2 if @t > 260
      if @t > 260 and Input.trigger?(Input::C)
        if @acto == 1
          Vacas.empezar_acto2
          $scene = Scene_Map.new
        elsif @acto == 2
          Vacas.empezar_acto3
          $scene = Scene_Map.new
        elsif @acto == 3
          Vacas.empezar_acto4
          $scene = Scene_Map.new
        else
          $scene = Scene_Title.new
        end
      end
      break if $scene != self
    end
    Graphics.freeze
    for s in [@fondo, @fin, @sub, @sig, @pie]
      s.bitmap.dispose
      s.dispose
    end
    Graphics.transition(60)
    Graphics.freeze
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# Vacas_Mente -- Combate frontal XP. Enemigos mentales; veneno nunca mata aqui.
#==============================================================================
module Vacas
  def self.preparar_mente(completo = false)
    for a in $game_party.actors
      # Tambien migra partidas anteriores sin reiniciar sus estadisticas.
      for id in [61, 62, 63, 64]
        a.learn_skill(id)
      end
      a.set_graphic(a.character_name, a.character_hue, 'steven_mente', 0)
      if completo
        a.recover_all
      else
        a.hp = [a.hp, a.maxhp * 3 / 4].max
        a.sp = [a.sp, a.maxsp * 3 / 4].max
      end
    end
  end
end
class Interpreter
  def preparar_mente
    Vacas.preparar_mente(true)
    return true
  end
end
class Scene_Map
  alias vacas_mente_call_battle call_battle
  def call_battle
    # Los encuentros aleatorios se limitan a estos mapas y fuera de patrullas.
    if $game_temp.battle_proc == nil
      unless Vacas.veneno >= 35 and [8, 9, 11].include?($game_map.map_id) and
          !$game_switches[26] and !$game_switches[29] and !$game_switches[30]
        $game_temp.battle_calling = false
        $game_player.make_encounter_count
        return
      end
      $game_temp.battle_can_lose = true
      $game_system.vacas_gastar_encuentro
    end
    Vacas.preparar_mente(false)
    $vacas_tone_antes = $game_screen.tone.clone
    $vacas_fondo_antes = $game_map.battleback_name
    troop = $game_temp.battle_troop_id
    fondo = [2, 8].include?(troop) ? 'piso' : ([3, 6, 14, 15, 16, 17].include?(troop) ? 'tunel' : 'matadero')
    $game_map.battleback_name = 'mente_' + fondo
    $game_screen.start_tone_change(Tone.new(-15, -20, -12, 45), 0)
    vacas_mente_call_battle
  end
end
class Game_Battler
  alias vacas_mente_skill_effect skill_effect
  def skill_effect(user, skill)
    effective = vacas_mente_skill_effect(user, skill)
    if $game_temp.in_battle and self.is_a?(Game_Actor)
      if user.is_a?(Game_Enemy) and effective
        extra = {65=>4, 66=>5, 67=>6, 68=>4, 69=>3, 70=>7}[skill.id]
        Vacas.veneno = [96, Vacas.veneno + extra].min if extra != nil
      elsif skill.id == 61
        self.sp += 18
        for id in [2, 3, 4]
          remove_state(id)
        end
        Vacas.veneno = Vacas.veneno - 6
        effective = true
      end
    end
    return effective
  end
end

module Vacas
  def self.bajo_ciudad?
    return $game_switches[113] && (17..21).include?($game_map.map_id)
  end
  def self.empezar_acto4
    return unless $game_switches[98]
    unless $game_switches[113]
      $game_switches[113] = true
      $game_switches[115] = true
      $game_variables[51] = $game_switches[96] ? 0 : 1
      $game_variables[52] = 100
      $game_variables[55] = 1
      $game_party.gain_item(30,1)
      $game_party.gain_item(31,2)
    end
    for id in [9,10,11,15,16,23,24,25,26,27,29,30,31,40,90,101]
      $game_switches[id] = false
    end
    $game_system.timer_working = false
    $game_system.menu_disabled = false
    $game_system.save_disabled = true
    $game_player.transparent = false
    $game_temp.player_new_map_id = 17
    $game_temp.player_new_x = 4
    $game_temp.player_new_y = 11
    $game_temp.player_new_direction = 8
    $game_temp.player_transferring = true
    $game_temp.transition_processing = false
  end
  def self.prueba_acto4(pruebas = false)
    prueba_acto3(pruebas)
    for id in [82,83,84,85,86,88,91,95,98,104,105,106]
      $game_switches[id] = true
    end
    $game_switches[96] = !pruebas
    $game_switches[97] = pruebas
    $game_variables[23] = pruebas ? 2 : 1
    $game_party.gain_item(28,1)
    $game_party.gain_item(29,1)
    empezar_acto4
    $game_temp.player_transferring = false
    $game_map.setup(17)
    $game_player.moveto(4,11)
    $game_player.turn_up
    $game_map.autoplay
    $game_map.update
  end
  def self.reputacion(n)
    $game_variables[51] = [[-3,$game_variables[51]+n].max,5].min
  end
  def self.recargar
    return false unless $game_party.item_number(31)>0 && $game_variables[52]<100
    $game_party.lose_item(31,1)
    $game_variables[52] = [$game_variables[52]+60,100].min
    $game_switches[115] = true
    return true
  end
  def self.detener_caza
    for id in [120,122,123,125]
      $game_switches[id] = false
    end
    $game_system.timer_working = false
    $game_system.menu_disabled = false
    $game_player.transparent = false
  end
  # Solo avanza en exploracion libre; menus, mensajes y combate no gastan pila.
  def self.actualizar_linterna
    return unless bajo_ciudad?
    return if $game_temp.message_window_showing || $game_system.map_interpreter.running?
    if Input.trigger?(Input::X)
      $game_switches[115] = !$game_switches[115] if $game_variables[52]>0
    end
    recargar if Input.trigger?(Input::Y)
    return if [20,21].include?($game_map.map_id)
    n = $game_variables[56]+1
    $game_variables[56] = n
    if $game_switches[115] && $game_variables[52]>0
      $game_variables[52] -= 1 if n%120==0
      $game_switches[115] = false if $game_variables[52]<=0
    elsif n%240==0
      self.veneno = [96,self.veneno+1].min
    end
  end
  class << self
    alias bajo_tareas_antes tareas
    def tareas
      return bajo_tareas_antes unless $game_switches[113]
      s=$game_switches
      return [["Pacto sellado. Acto V: matadero nocturno.",false]] if s[132]
      return [["Hablar con la Guernsey. Elegir el pacto.",false]] if s[131]
      return [["Camara: escuchar a la Guernsey.",false]] if s[118]
      return [["Valvulas: cerrar retorno, abrir descarga.",false]] if s[119]
      return [["Buscar rueda en los tuneles. Altar al este.",false]]
    end
  end

# Mascara con radio cercano y cono orientado; no ocupa Pictures 98 ni toca tono.
# Solo cinco bitmaps compartidos por spriteset, se liberan al transferir.
class Sprite_Linterna < Sprite
  def initialize(viewport = nil)
    super(viewport)
    self.z=2900
    @mascaras={}
    @direccion=nil
  end
  def mascara(d)
    return @mascaras[d] if @mascaras[d]
    b=Bitmap.new(1280,960)
    b.fill_rect(0,0,1280,960,Color.new(1,8,7,218))
    # Crear agujero por franjas horizontales; no hay get_pixel por fotograma.
    for y in -190..190
      (-190).step(190,4) do |x|
        dist=Math.sqrt(x*x+y*y)
        near=d==0 ? 35 : 57
        forward = d==2 ? y : d==8 ? -y : d==6 ? x : -x
        cross = (d==2 || d==8) ? x.abs : y.abs
        beam=d!=0 && forward>0 && forward<182 && cross<forward*0.52+12
        next unless dist<near || beam
        edge=dist<near ? dist/near : [forward/182.0,cross/(forward*0.52+12)].max
        a=[0,((edge-0.45)*330).to_i].max
        a=[218,a].min
        b.fill_rect(640+x,480+y,4,1,Color.new(1,8,7,a))
      end
    end
    @mascaras[d]=b
    return b
  end
  def update
    super
    on=Vacas.bajo_ciudad? && ![20,21].include?($game_map.map_id)
    self.visible=on
    return unless on
    d=$game_switches[115] && $game_variables[52]>0 ? $game_player.direction : 0
    if @direccion!=d
      self.bitmap=mascara(d)
      @direccion=d
    end
    self.x=$game_player.screen_x-640
    self.y=$game_player.screen_y-18-480
  end
  def dispose
    for b in @mascaras.values
      b.dispose
    end
    super
  end
end
